BiblicalUsage: ʼEthnan was an Israelite of the house of Ashhur, named among the sons of Helah in Judah's genealogy. He appears once, in Chronicles. His fuller story is on his People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ethnan matters the way every name in the genealogy matters: God kept the record, and He kept this name in it.
